main.description: A single nomination cast by one Bluesky account for another, for the '25 Most Influential Bluesky Posters of 2026' leaderboard. One record per (voter, target) pair, never overwritten — the running tally and each voter's 10-nomination cap are computed by clients watching Jetstream and scanning the network for this collection, not stored in the record itself. Written and read by influential25 (https://influential25.bisks.net).

target.description: DID of the account being nominated.

createdAt.description: When the nomination was cast, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
